scope: Trial checked system optimization with durable per-setting backups and independent current-user Temp/icon/Explorer maintenance.
verified: Backup must exist with captured originals and durable intent before injected mutation.
Per-item partial verification failure retains recovery information; subsequent selected items have separate outcomes.
Restore reverses applied/partial entries, exact originals and absent-value/type metadata; repeated restore skips completed entries.
Context mismatch and unknown actions/phases, XML DTD, oversized backup policy, corrupt/invalid string data and unwritable paths refuse unsafe recovery/mutation.
Cancellation finishes current write/verification/journal then stops later items.
Temp fixture retains recent/locked/protected tool files and data outside its root; directory links/root redirection rejected; partial cancellation counts preserved.
Appx exact plaintext commands parse and execute only mocked volume operations; existing/new/ambiguous/missing/or denied volumes checked.
New page is idle on entry, confirmation cancel does nothing, selected scope/backup/restore/details, independent maintenance and Temp retention options verified.
Original startup performs no child process; old default-app, cleanup kernel, WOL, power dispatch and automation logic preserved.
not_verified_in_linux: Actual Windows power plan creation/activation and hardware AC/DC/lid response.
Win10/11 UI effects, actual registry policy enforcement and Win7 unsupported-item behavior.
Physical D drive bus classification, permissions, known-folder redirection and Appx default registration.
NTP synchronization and time-service restore on actual domain/non-domain devices.
Actual user Temp handle deletion and current-session Explorer kill/restart.
Native MoveFileEx backup replacement on real NTFS/FAT32/exFAT USB media.
Windows-only disposable HKCU restore/native read-only power/fixture handle-deletion checks are included in Run-Windows but not executed here.
Antivirus verdicts and physical machine deployment.
security_scope: No new automatic Defender, firewall or UAC disabling; read-only safety status and official UAC settings entry only. No policy-bypass, encoded command or executable backup data.
feature_boundaries: Defaults: 10 recommended settings; 4 explicit D/web/update selections.
Preview enables handlers/thumbnails; current pane remains a supported Alt+P choice.
Web reset is current-user proxy/PAC/legacy homepage, not universal browser-policy or shortcut repair.
Default D folders change known-folder paths, never migrate/delete old data; Appx default is distinct from EXE installers.
Update option writes NoAutoUpdate policy; does not claim permanent disable or universal enforcement.
Restoration concerns settings, not clock rollback, cache/Temp contents or deletion of D data.
environment_helpers: Unchanged; not retested for this feature.
screenshots: Injected mock changes/results, not evidence of real Windows optimization.
